scripts.db:seed:local: bun run db:seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute aidc-bench-db --local --yes --file=seed_public_v1.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: bun run db:seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute aidc-bench-db --remote --yes --file=seed_public_v1.sql
scripts.db:sync:remote: bun run db:migrate:remote && bun run db:seed:remote
scripts.build:ci: bun install --cwd ../web --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run typecheck && bun run db:seed:gen
scripts.deploy:ci: bun run db:sync:remote && bun run deploy
